sets.q: Which number is NOT divisible by 8?
sets.why: 60 ÷ 8 = 7 R 4. Something is left over, so 60 is not divisible by 8.
no: 8 × 8 = 64 with nothing left over, so 64 is divisible by 8.
8 × 6 = 48 with nothing left over, so 48 is divisible by 8.
8 × 9 = 72 with nothing left over, so 72 is divisible by 8.

sets.q: Bailey multiplied 9 × 7 = 63 to show for sure that 63 ÷ 7 = 9 is right. She used multiplication to ____ her answer. (Use a word from your word cards.)

sets.q: Fishlegs did not say "about 6." He said 45 ÷ 7 = 6 R 3, the exact answer. His answer was ____. (Use a word from your word cards.)
sets.why: Precise means exactly right, with every detail correct. Check: 6 × 7 + 3 = 45.
